en.headline: Swedish food museum stays at Kai Tak Airside until late November
en.dek: The Disgusting Food Museum, on its first Hong Kong run, is at GATE33 in Airside through 26 November, with weekday and weekend hours published by the organisers.
body: The Disgusting Food Museum, a travelling exhibition that began in Malmö, is in the middle of its first Hong Kong run at GATE33 Gallery on the third floor of Airside in Kai Tak. Listings put the dates at 29 September to 26 November 2026.

The organisers describe the show as a display of more than 80 foods that are ordinary in one place and contentious in another, using samples, models, photographs, video and scent installations. Items named in the public listings include Swedish fermented herring and an Italian cheese associated with live maggots. The exhibition also includes insects and laboratory-grown meat as part of a section on future food.

Opening hours published with the Hong Kong run are noon to 8pm from Monday to Thursday, and 11am to 9pm on Fridays, Saturdays, Sundays and public holidays. Adult admission was listed at HK$68 on weekdays and HK$88 on Fridays, weekends and public holidays, with lower concession rates for students, children aged 4 to 11 and people aged 65 or above. Children aged 3 or under were listed as free if accompanied by a ticketed adult.
Airside is at 2 Concorde Road, Kai Tak, beside Kai Tak station. The run is a temporary tenancy rather than a permanent museum.

zh.headline: 瑞典「嘔心食物」展暫駐啟德AIRSIDE至11月底
zh.dek: 源自瑞典馬爾默的「嘔心食物博物館」首度來港，在啟德AIRSIDE三樓GATE33展出至11月26日，平日與周末開放時間不同。
body: 源自瑞典馬爾默的巡迴展覽「嘔心食物博物館」正在啟德AIRSIDE三樓GATE33藝文館作香港首站。公開資料列出的展期為2026年9月29日至11月26日。
主辦方介紹，展覽匯集八十多款在不同地方或平常、或惹爭議的食物，以實物、模型、相片、影像及氣味裝置展出。公開名單提到的展品包括瑞典發酵鯡魚罐頭，以及一種與活蛆有關的意大利芝士。展覽亦有昆蟲食材及實驗室培植肉，談及未來飲食。
隨展覽公布的開放時間為星期一至四中午12時至晚上8時，星期五、六、日及公眾假期則為上午11時至晚上9時。成人門票平日列為68元，星期五、周末及公眾假期列為88元；學生、4至11歲小童及65歲或以上長者有特惠票。3歲或以下小童在已購票成人陪同下可免費入場。
AIRSIDE位於啟德協調道2號，鄰近啟德站。這是短期租用場地的巡迴展，並非常設博物館。
